claims.text: AI permission depends on the course. The 2026 education policy asks programmes to specify permitted uses; example levels are not assigned permissions for every course.

evidence.quote:
To support clarity, courses and programmes should specify permitted AI use using defined levels, for
example:

Level 0 – No AI use permitted
Level 1 – AI support (e.g. grammar, language, feedback)
Level 2 – AI-assisted work (co-creation with clear disclosure)
Level 3 – AI-dominated output (not permitted for summative assessment)
evidence.title: Responsible Use of (Generative)AI in Education, version 6.3, FINAL June 2026
evidence.location: Section 8; physical PDF page 11; physical PDF page 11

topics.evidenceScope: Students must follow course-specific rules; level 3 AI-dominated output is not permitted for summative assessment in the policy’s example scale.

topics.title: 披露
topics.summary: 获准使用 AI 时必须披露；实质性使用须记录工具及版本、用途与贡献程度，课程要求时另记录交互细节。
topics.scope: 2026 年教育政策第 8 节；不将旧附录模板作为当前通用格式。

claims.text: When AI use is permitted, disclosure is mandatory. Substantive use records the tool/version, purpose and contribution; interaction details are required where the course asks.

evidence.quote: When AI use is permitted, disclosure is mandatory.

topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.summary: 不得向公开 AI 工具输入个人、学生、研究或保密数据，并应假定输入可能存储于外部。
topics.scope: 限公开 AI 服务；获批科研环境须另核适用范围。

claims.text: Do not enter personal, student, research or confidential data in public AI tools; assume inputs may be stored externally.

evidence.quote: Always assume your input may be stored externally. Never include personal data, student details, research data or confidential material in public AI tools.
evidence.title: AI in education research and administration; last edited Oct 20 2026
evidence.location: {"section": "FAQ: How should I handle data when using AI tools?", "physicalPdfPage": null, "printedPage": null, "lineNumbers": null}

topics.title: 研究与发表

topics.scope: 仅限科研指引，不套用课程披露规则，也不声称已确认全校规章批准。
